_about: editor-runtime (Editor & Terminal): wording, conditions, units and bounds from the plain-pages audit (2026-09-27). Hand rows autosave, file-encoding, paste-protect and index-mode are worded here too. The index actions keep the flows they had in 90-flows.json. Editor look rows (pm7-editor-customizer, 2026-10-14): the canon look rows and the proposed ones (src/settings/proposed.d) are worded here.

code.editing.autosave.label: Save files automatically
code.editing.autosave.help: Saves a moment after you stop typing.

code.editing.default-encoding.label: Text encoding for new files
code.editing.default-encoding.help: Used when a file does not say which encoding it uses.

general.interaction.max-editor-tabs.label: Most editor tabs open at once
general.interaction.max-editor-tabs.help: Past it, the editor tab you used least recently closes. Pinned tabs and tabs with unsaved changes stay, and other kinds of tab don't count.

general.startup.max-persisted-tabs.label: Tabs reopened next time
general.startup.max-persisted-tabs.help: Tabs of every kind. The ones you used least recently are left out first, and each panel's open tab and pinned tabs always come back.

general.interaction.hide-ignored-files.label: Hide ignored files
general.interaction.hide-ignored-files.help: Hides build output and other ignored files; off dims them.

general.interaction.expand-current-file.label: Show the open file in the file tree

general.interaction.drop-action.label: Dragging files
general.interaction.drop-action.help: Hold Shift while dragging to do the other.

general.interaction.drop-conflict.label: If a dropped file has the same name

general.interaction.row-cap.label: Most files listed per folder
general.interaction.row-cap.help: Stops giant folders from freezing the app.

code.editing.diagnostics-visibility.label: Problems to highlight
code.editing.diagnostics-visibility.help: Which code problems are marked in the editor.

code.editing.tab-size.label: Tab size
code.editing.tab-size.help: Columns in a level of indentation. A file with its own keeps it while the editor follows it.

code.editing.insert-spaces.label: Indent with
code.editing.insert-spaces.help: What a new level is made of in a file that doesn't already say.

code.editing.detect-indentation.label: Follow the file's indentation
code.editing.detect-indentation.help: A file indented with 2 spaces keeps 2; one indented with tabs keeps tabs.

code.editing.goto-highlight-ms.label: How long a jumped-to line stays lit

code.editing.editor-strip-collapsed.label: Start with the editor panel folded away

code.editing.large-file-threshold.label: Preview files longer than
code.editing.large-file-threshold.help: Longer files open as a preview with a Load all button.

code.editing.max-file-size-mb.label: Never open files larger than
code.editing.max-file-size-mb.help: Bigger files show a notice instead of freezing the app.

code.terminal.shell.label: Shell
code.terminal.shell.help: The command-line program in new terminals.

code.terminal.cwd.label: Start new terminals in
code.terminal.cwd.help: Leave empty for the project folder.

code.terminal.startup-command.label: Command to run in every new terminal

options.Restore Last Layout: Bring them back as I left them

code.terminal.kill-confirm.label: Closing a terminal that is still running

hints.Ask First: You choose each time whether to stop what is running.

code.terminal.sticky-header.label: Keep each command's title in view

code.terminal.readability-signals.label: Easier-to-read output
code.terminal.readability-signals.help: Line numbers, highlights and markers in long output.

code.terminal.transcript-retention.label: Keep terminal output for
code.terminal.transcript-retention.help: Longer helps when debugging but uses more disk.

code.terminal.paste-protection.label: Check before pasting several lines
code.terminal.paste-protection.help: Shows pasted commands first when they could run more than one thing.

code.terminal.allowed-profiles.label: Shells this project may use
code.terminal.allowed-profiles.help: The Shell above must be one of these.

code.terminal.tab-role.label: Purpose of new terminal tabs
code.terminal.tab-role.help: Only a label; it never changes what runs. Each tab's menu can change it.

code.terminal.font-rendering.label: Text drawing
code.terminal.font-rendering.help: Try Crisp if terminal text looks blurry.

code.terminal.performance-mode.label: Speed over looks
code.terminal.performance-mode.help: Less polish so heavy output stays fast.

code.terminal.shell-integration.label: Smart shell features
code.terminal.shell-integration.help: Whether command blocks and folder tracking are active.

readout.false: Not active: the shell does not report commands

code.terminal.diagnostics-logging.label: Record terminal debug details
code.terminal.diagnostics-logging.help: Leave off unless support asks for it.

web.index.enable.label: Keep a search index of this project
web.index.enable.help: Off stops indexing and clears what was built.

web.index.mode.label: How much to index
web.index.mode.help: Deep finds more but uses more of your computer.

web.index.exclusion-patterns.label: Leave out of search
web.index.exclusion-patterns.help: Folders and files to skip, on top of the built-in list.

web.index.follow-symlinks.label: Follow linked folders
web.index.follow-symlinks.help: Linked folders must still be inside the project.

web.index.remote-cache-mode.label: Copy kept on this computer
web.index.remote-cache-mode.help: Remote projects only: index a lighter copy locally first.

web.index.rebuild.label: Rebuild the index
web.index.rebuild.help: Use it when search results look stale or wrong.

flow.message: Frees 412 MB on this computer. Search builds the index again the next time it needs it, which can take a few minutes.

web.index.evict-cache.label: Clear the index
web.index.evict-cache.help: Frees the space; search rebuilds it when needed.

code.editing.color-scheme.label: Editor colors
code.editing.color-scheme.help: Follow look uses the look's own code colors. Any scheme the terminal offers works here too.

code.editing.line-height.label: Editor line spacing
code.editing.line-height.help: A multiple of the text size.

code.editing.minimap.label: Minimap scrollbar
code.editing.minimap.help: Off draws a plain scrollbar with the change marks.

code.editing.sticky-scroll.label: Sticky scroll
code.editing.sticky-scroll.help: Keeps the lines that open the block you are reading at the top.

code.editing.diff-layout.label: Diff layout
code.editing.diff-layout.help: Automatic shows the two sides side by side when the tab is wide enough.

code.editing.scheme-pair.label: Switch editor colors with light and dark

code.editing.bracket-pair-colors.label: Bracket pair colors
code.editing.bracket-pair-colors.help: Matching brackets share a color, a new one at each depth.

code.editing.min-contrast.label: Editor text contrast
code.editing.min-contrast.help: 7:1 moves dim colors lighter or darker; their hue stays.

code.editing.token-colors.label: Token colours
code.editing.token-colors.help: One kind of word in one scheme, as scheme/kind: #rrggbb. Set them in the editor's Customize screen, under Colors.

code.editing.font-weight.label: Editor text weight
code.editing.font-weight.help: JetBrains Mono 400 to 800, Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono 200 to 800.

code.editing.ligatures.label: Ligatures
code.editing.ligatures.help: Joins -> and != into one symbol where the font has them.

code.editing.cursor-trail.label: Trail when the caret jumps
code.editing.cursor-trail.help: Only for jumps of several lines you did not click.

code.editing.indent-guides-active.label: Light the guide of the block I'm in

code.editing.rulers.label: Rulers
code.editing.rulers.help: Faint lines at the columns lines should stay within.

code.editing.reveal-lines.label: Lines arrive when a file opens

code.editing.scanlines.label: Scanlines
code.editing.scanlines.help: Thin still lines across the code, like an old monitor.

code.editing.text-glow.label: Text glow
code.editing.text-glow.help: A soft glow around code in its own color.
